newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: ALPINE SKIING-REITER WINS MEN'S WORLD CUP SLALOM.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-REITER WINS MEN'S WORLD CUP SLALOM.

text.p: Austria's Mario Reiter won a men's Alpine skiing World Cup slalom race on Sunday in a time of one minute 36.09 seconds, according to provisional results.
Italy's Alberto Tomba was second in 1:36.28 and Norwegian Finn Christian Jagge finished third with 1:36.54.
Lasse Kjus of Norway won the combined event which comprised Sunday's slalom and Saturday's downhill.
